name: upscale_video
description: Finish existing video with Starlight Precise 2.6 through fal. Requires video_url and measured source_duration_seconds, source_fps, source_width and source_height. Choose target_resolution 1080p/4K or upscale_factor 1–4; default is 2x. Optional target_fps 16–60. H264_output defaults true. All paid submissions pause with cost, including autonomous runs. Unknown quotes block live submission. Default dry-run is a preview, not media. Poll get_video_task with download=true and inspect the saved MP4. Outputs are not training eligible.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS source video or renderhaus-asset:// version handle for preview. Resolve Studio handles before live submission.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured source duration in seconds, greater than zero and at most 300. Required for a cost estimate.

source_fps.description: Measured positive source frame rate. Used to compute output and price, never sent to fal.

source_width.description: Measured positive source width in pixels. Output must fit landscape or portrait 4K.

source_height.description: Measured positive source height in pixels. Output must fit landscape or portrait 4K.

upscale_factor.description: Scale both dimensions by 1 to 4. Defaults to 2 when target_resolution is absent.

target_resolution.description: Optional 1080p or 4K short-edge target preserving aspect. Must agree with any supplied upscale_factor.

target_fps.description: Optional output FPS. Upscale accepts 16 to 60; interpolation accepts 16 to 120 and defaults to 60. Changing FPS during upscale adds Apollo interpolation.

model.description: Upscale uses Starlight Precise 2.6. Interpolation uses Apollo by default or Chronos for plain linear-motion FPS conversion. Direct aliases slp-2.6, apo-8 and chr-2 normalize to fal names.

softness.description: Optional Starlight Precise 2.6 softness from 1, sharpest, to 5, softest. Unset uses Topaz's default.

H264_output.description: Use H264 for browser playback. Defaults to true; fal's default H265 can require a compatible player.

name: interpolate_video
description: Finish existing video with Apollo by default; use Chronos for plain linear-motion FPS conversion unless the user names a model. Requires video_url and measured source_duration_seconds, source_fps, source_width and source_height. Choose target_fps 16–120 or fps_multiplier; default is 60 FPS. slowdown_factor 1–8 defaults 1; slow-motion prices remain unknown and live submission is blocked. All paid submissions pause with cost even in autonomous runs. Poll get_video_task with download=true. Dry-run previews are not media; outputs are not training eligible.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS source video or renderhaus-asset:// version handle for preview. Resolve Studio handles before live submission.

source_duration_seconds.description: Measured source duration in seconds, greater than zero and at most 300. Required for a cost estimate.

source_fps.description: Measured positive source frame rate. Used to compute output and price, never sent to fal.

source_width.description: Measured positive source width in pixels. Output must fit landscape or portrait 4K.

source_height.description: Measured positive source height in pixels. Output must fit landscape or portrait 4K.

target_fps.description: Optional output FPS. Upscale accepts 16 to 60; interpolation accepts 16 to 120 and defaults to 60. Changing FPS during upscale adds Apollo interpolation.

fps_multiplier.description: Optional multiplier of measured source_fps for interpolation. Supply this or target_fps, with an integral result from 16 to 120.

model.description: Upscale uses Starlight Precise 2.6. Interpolation uses Apollo by default or Chronos for plain linear-motion FPS conversion. Direct aliases slp-2.6, apo-8 and chr-2 normalize to fal names.

slowdown_factor.description: Integer 1 to 8. Multiplies output duration at the target FPS. Unverified prices remain preview-only.

H264_output.description: Use H264 for browser playback. Defaults to true; fal's default H265 can require a compatible player.

name: get_video_task
description: Poll the exact saved Topaz job_id once without resubmitting. download=true saves and validates the completed MP4. Dry-run handles remain previews across configuration changes. Output provenance retains Topaz and the selected model.

job_id.description: Exact Topaz handle returned by a submit tool. Contains model identity for polling after a restart.

download.description: Download a completed video and validate its MP4 video container before reporting an artifact.

name: list_topaz_models
description: List verified finishing models, endpoint identifiers, service licences and documented price examples locally. Free, no credentials or network calls. Does not verify account access or live behavior.
